Objective

With 7 years of experience in Compensation & Benefits at a financial services firm with over 500 employees, I aim to leverage my in-depth knowledge of payroll, benefits structuring, and compliance to develop competitive and equitable reward systems. My goal is to contribute to a performance-driven culture by designing C&B strategies that align with business objectives, enhance employee satisfaction, and support talent retention. I seek to further grow within a dynamic HR team where analytical precision and strategic thinking are valued.

Work experience

C&B Specialist

(

2018

>

Present

)

SVT Financial Group, Inc.

  1. Administered monthly payroll for 500+ employees, ensuring 100% accuracy and compliance with tax and labor regulations.
  2. Developed and maintained C&B policies aligned with internal grading structures and market benchmarks to ensure fairness and competitiveness.
  3. Coordinated annual salary reviews and performance bonus schemes, providing analysis and proposals to HR leadership and finance teams.
  4. Managed employee benefits programs (healthcare, insurance, allowances), including vendor liaison, employee communication, and issue resolution.
  5. Conducted regular salary surveys and market research, benchmarking compensation practices to support strategic HR planning.
  6. Ensured compliance with labor laws and internal audit requirements, regularly updating internal records and documentation to meet regulatory standards.

C&B Executive

(

2013

>

2018

MW Travel

  1. Processed monthly payroll for over 200 employees, ensuring timely payments and accurate deductions related to tax, insurance, and attendance.
  2. Maintained and updated employee records, including salary, benefits, and leave data, using internal HRIS for smooth audit and reporting.
  3. Assisted in administering employee benefits programs, such as travel allowances, healthcare, and bonuses, to enhance employee satisfaction.
  4. Supported compliance with labor laws by preparing statutory reports (e.g., social insurance, PIT) and liaising with government agencies.
  5. Prepared C&B reports and analytics (e.g., turnover cost, salary structure) to support decision-making by HR managers and finance teams.
  6. Participated in payroll audits and internal reviews, ensuring that all processes aligned with company policies and legal standards.
